title: Verify the W7.11 tutor_live_mark_blocked analytics event fires in mark_live_completion_invariant_test.dart
why: The forbidden-write branch deliberately fires an analytics event (W7.11) so tutor-boundary violations are visible in dashboards. The test never passes an AnalyticsService, so _analytics stays null and the `_analytics?.logEvent(...)` call is always a silent no-op — the test cannot distinguish 'analytics fired correctly' from 'analytics wiring is broken.' Repo-wide grep confirms liveMarkBlocked/tutor_live_mark_blocked is referenced nowhere under test/, so this dashboard signal has zero regression coverage.
recommendation: Add a case that injects a hand-written fake or mocktail mock AnalyticsService and asserts logEvent(LogEvents.tutor.liveMarkBlocked) fires exactly once on the tutor-forbidden path and never on the owner/child-self path.
acceptance_criteria: A test in mark_live_completion_invariant_test.dart injects an AnalyticsService fake and verifies logEvent(LogEvents.tutor.liveMarkBlocked) fires on the tutor-forbidden path
